headline: Learn the 4 heart valves in order of blood flow
body: Tricuspid (right atrium to right ventricle), Pulmonary (to the lungs), Mitral (left atrium to left ventricle), Aortic (to the body).

headline: Your taste cells are replaced about every 10 days
stat_note: lifespan of a taste receptor cell
body: The average adult has about 2,000 to 10,000 taste buds, and their receptor cells are constantly renewed.

headline: Tooth enamel is the hardest substance in your body
stat_note: of enamel is mineral, mostly calcium and phosphorus
body: The rest is about 4% water and 1% protein. Unlike bone, enamel does not grow back once it is lost.
